A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SPELL research. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support comparison; relocated sections and displays can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v2 reports original SPELL experiments across 12 language models, including benchmark results, ablations, and additional evaluations and training analyses in Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons and the additional evaluations and analyses now in Appendix F.

M1.justification: The three-role policy, history curriculum, grounding filter, reward functions, sampling, and optimization remain unchanged. Removing 'trivially' from the grounding-filter description does not change the procedure already specified in Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both retain DocMath and Ultra-Fineweb training data and the same three training task formats. Coverage also retains the six main QA benchmarks and the appendix evaluations on short-context reasoning, MRCR, and HELMET.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments: RLVR, external-judge variants, official and reimplemented LongPO, SoLoPO, QwenLong-L1, and the AZR/R-Zero reward mappings remain in Tables 1, 4, 9 and Figure 5.

E3.justification: Both retain 16K training, 16K/100K main evaluation, the same model configurations, 4K/20K output limits, temperature 0.7, and top-p 0.95. Data construction, truncation, scoring, and appendix evaluation procedures also match.

E4.justification: The role ablations, reward-mapping comparisons, group-size and sigma sensitivity, external-judge experiment, training-cost analysis, role dynamics, and reward-hacking analyses are retained. Table 3 merely reverses the order of the two hyperparameter groups.

E5.justification: Both retain the stated eight-run averaging, eight sampled responses per evaluation query, and the same pass@k estimator. No seed information, uncertainty-reporting practice, or statistical testing procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: The numerical results and plotted findings match after relocation and reordering. For example, both report 100K pass@8 scores of 74.5 for SPELL, 68.1 for RLVR, and 66.9 for the original Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking model. Appendix Tables 7–9 are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–12 and their mathematical reasoning are retained, including the reward definitions, advantage estimates, pass@k estimator, and sigma selection argument. Reordering the hyperparameter discussion introduces no new derivation, assumption, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of label-free three-role self-improvement, broad model gains, and improved test-time scaling, including the 7.6-point pass@8 gain. The conclusion's 'outputs' to 'tasks' wording change does not substantively redefine the contribution.

C2.justification: The curriculum and verifier interpretations, failure-mode discussions, and applicability limitations remain unchanged. The limitations concerning missing co-evolution theory, 16K training, and human-designed preprocessing and prompts move from Appendix A to B.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, model and dataset identifiers, prompts, hardware, training time, and reproduction instructions are retained. The existing code-repository link moves from the author-area front matter into the abstract; this does not establish new resource availability.

R1.justification: Related Work moves intact from v2 Section 2 to v3 Appendix C. The cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to earlier long-context alignment and self-play research remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 relocates Related Work, reorders the hyperparameter discussion and two implementation subsections, and adds acknowledgements and an LLM writing-assistance statement. It also updates publication and affiliation information and removes a redundant grounding sentence; most prose is retained.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 2 to page 1 at a smaller size, and Figure 3 moves beneath Table 1. Table 3 reverses its sigma/group-size blocks and updates its caption. Other changes mainly concern placement and page breaks; all eight figures and nine tables remain.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding and writing-assistance disclosures and modest copyediting, including removal of the misplaced grounding sentence after Eq. 4. These provide limited polish, while the scientific argument, experimental support, limitations, and reproducibility information remain substantively identical. The reorganization and layout adjustments do not materially strengthen or weaken overall paper quality.
